title: Name the first shipping blocker
prompt: Return "pay" if unpaid; otherwise "address" if the address is invalid; otherwise "stock" if stock is zero or less; otherwise "ready". The priority order is part of the contract.

tests.label: Payment first
tests.hint: Check payment before the other blockers.

hints: Test blockers in the required priority order.
Each early return ends the function, so later conditions are not consulted.
explanation: Named outcomes tell callers why work cannot continue. Order matters when several conditions fail at once.
chapterTitle: Controlling Program Decisions with Conditional Logic
